components.name: Project Disclosure
components.description: Native details and summary with ruled boundaries, plus/minus state and readable supporting text.
components.html:
Selected project

Project description and engineering context.
components.css: .ds-project{background:var(--charcoal,#242723);color:var(--paper,#f3f2ee);border-block:1px solid #54594f;font-family:var(--font-inter,Inter),sans-serif;line-height:1.65}.ds-project summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:30px 0}.ds-project summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-project h3{margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.35rem,2.6vw,2.25rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.04em;transition:color .2s}.ds-project summary:hover h3{color:#ea946a}.ds-project summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ea946a;outline-offset:6px;border-radius:2px}.ds-toggle{width:44px;height:44px;flex-shrink:0;display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-minus,.ds-project[open] .ds-plus{display:none}.ds-project[open] .ds-minus{display:block}.ds-details{padding:0 0 34px;animation:ds-detail-arrive .35s ease-out}.ds-details p{margin:0;color:#bfc2b8;max-width:65ch;line-height:1.75;font-size:15px}@keyframes ds-detail-arrive{from{transform:translateY(-6px);opacity:.6}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-project summary{padding-block:22px;gap:12px}.ds-project h3{font-size:23px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-details p{font-size:14px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-project h3{transition:none}.ds-details{animation:none}}

narrative.overview: Warm paper, dark ink, burnt orange and restrained serif emphasis support a professional, personal portfolio. Broad open sections give engineering content room to breathe; thin rules organize repeated material. Supplied portraits and a coffee animation bring the person into the same visual language as the work. This specification records the current Portfolio component and portfolio stylesheet; it does not expand the system using retained legacy components.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with a dark work section
Confident Inter headings with selective italic Fraunces accents
Open layouts, understated controls and ruled native disclosures
Purposeful motion that respects reduced-motion preferences

rules.name: The Surface Contrast Rule
rules.body: Carry the dark section's lighter text, accent and focus treatment together when using its charcoal background.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper, charcoal and orange relationship and lighter accent on dark surfaces.
Do use ruled content, bounded paragraphs and restrained serif emphasis.
Do retain keyboard focus, native disclosure behavior, visible media controls and reduced-motion support.
Do preserve supplied personal imagery and truthful project and career content.
donts: Don't infer new portfolio tokens from retained legacy components or the unused mono font.
Don't turn descriptive technology labels into interactive pills without a real interaction.
Don't hide content or required interaction behind motion.
